environment.description: ECS Fargate cluster running in 'production' VPC. Service deployed in 'worker-namespace' with Envoy sidecar in permissive mode (PERMISSIVE mTLS). No Istio AuthorizationPolicy applied. Task IAM role has ecs:UpdateService and ecs:DescribeServices permissions. Service is accessible from any pod in the mesh via ClusterIP. ALB routes external traffic with X-Forwarded-For header preservation enabled.
